action_target_contract.source: detached native future plan through op_tangent_v1 before mission braking, with measured state and vehicle limits

coherence_definition: Each anchor has mean and maximum interval residuals for position, velocity and yaw up to 1 s. Yaw uses raw relative plan angles as consumed by the controller, without modulo wrapping. Cumulative maxima use successive sums of those signed interval residuals. Secant maxima compare each endpoint velocity, acceleration and yaw rate separately with the corresponding interval finite difference, preventing opposite endpoint cancellation. Initial values compare native measured state. Mean/p95/max aggregate over anchors globally and by episode. Target uses the same function.
